name: Tokage Misumi
source:
One of the eight Hakkenshi, she is also one of the four head executives in the Gotou Faction.
She despises her brother, up to the point that she acts hostile to any men wearing glasses like him. 
She has an executive title called "Reineri", but this is rarely known even in the entire Gotou Faction. Only a few members of her troops use this title. She has a more popularly known title called "The Ripper Lizard", which as the name implies, reveals that she is a master of bladed weaponry, from Katana to Spear, or even [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chain_whip]Qijiebian[/url].
